title: Title
description: Source title metadata belonging to a translation or book: visible text, title type, canonical flag and subtype, word-level tokens and spans, and source content when supplied. Supported source formats map to OSIS-equivalent semantics.

type.description: OSIS title type, such as main, chapter, section or psalm.

canonical.description: Whether the source marks the title canonical; absent when the source does not say.

tokens.description: Word-level tokens in reading order; present with spans when the source carries OSIS word markup.

spans.description: Annotations over token and word ranges; present with tokens.

attrs.description: Source attributes retained as strings. Content links use reference_id or footnote_id to identify chapter study entries.
